source_semantics: Curve reload reads the initialized Box<Account<BondingCurve>> pointer storage as a Copy shared reference to the same Account. It does not read/copy a Box or Account owner. DefaultGlobalBox with a Sized referent has documented single-pointer representation.

Accounts reload starts with the shared outer reference a:&&mutAdminCto. It changes that outer pointer to *const&AdminCto and reads an initialized shared-reference value from the slot containing the original mutable reference. It never creates another &mut value.

Both loaded shared references are consumed immediately for creator scalar/reference copy or pool.owner comparison; no mutation/move/replacement of either source pointer or pointee occurs until after their use ends. No field offset of Context or Anchor Account is assumed.
No integer-pointer conversion occurs. Provenance and validity must remain attached to the live borrowed accounts/Box allocation. Volatile supplies no synchronization or aliasing exemption.
